text:
Yara knows Farah saw her put the brooch in the black trunk. Yara does not know that Farah watched Luca’s later moves through the window, so she thinks Farah still believes the brooch is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: C

Luca’s final move takes the brooch from the blue drawer to the wicker basket, where it remains.

ANSWER: C

Yara misses Farah’s announcement, but she sees Luca’s later moves. The last move she sees is Luca putting the brooch in the wicker basket, so that is where she thinks it is.

ANSWER: A

Tariq hears Farah say the brooch is in the blue drawer, and Luca’s text confirms it. Tariq neither sees nor is told about any later move, so he still thinks it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Tariq opens the blue drawer first. He hears Farah say the brooch is there, and Luca’s text confirms it. Tariq does not see or hear about any later move.

ANSWER: A

Yara knows Farah saw her put the brooch in the black trunk. Farah then left, and Yara doesn’t know Farah watched Luca’s later moves through the window. So Yara expects Farah to open the black trunk first and waits beside it.

ANSWER: B

Yara saw Tariq watch Oksana move the brooch to the blue drawer. She does not know that Tariq heard Farah through the window or that Luca texted him. As far as Yara knows, Tariq missed all the moves after he left, so she thinks he still believes the brooch is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Mirela hears Pablo read out “Denver” in step 6 and receives the same information from him in step 8. She does not hear the Nairobi reassignment in step 7 or receive Luca’s private message in step 9. So she still believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: D

Amara last reassigned the Marlow account to the Nairobi office in step 7. She did not receive either later direct message, so her belief remains unchanged.

ANSWER: D

Mirela says the Denver office. She overheard Pablo read “Denver” on call 6, and his direct message in step 8 confirmed it. She missed the reassignment to Nairobi on call 7 and did not receive Luca’s private message to Pablo.

ANSWER: C

Amara’s reassignment to Nairobi in step 7 is the last actual change. The direct messages in steps 8 and 9 do not reassign the account, so it remains with the Nairobi office.

ANSWER: C

Tariq knows Farah saw him watch Oksana move the brooch to the blue drawer. From Tariq’s perspective, Farah has no reason to think he learned of any later move. So he thinks Farah still believes his answer would be “the blue drawer.”

ANSWER: C

Quinn heard Pablo read out “Denver” on call 6. Pablo wasn’t on call 7 when Amara changed the assignment to Nairobi, and Quinn doesn’t know about Luca’s private message to Pablo. So Quinn thinks Pablo still believes the Marlow account is with the Denver office.

ANSWER: D

Oksana thinks the last placement Luca knows Tariq saw was the first one, in the black trunk. Luca was absent when Tariq saw the move to the blue drawer, and Tariq was already outside when Luca heard Farah’s announcement. Oksana knows neither that Tariq overheard it nor that Luca texted him afterward. So she thinks Luca still believes Tariq would look in the black trunk.

ANSWER: B

Luca knows the brooch is in the wicker basket. Oksana and Yara saw Luca put it there, so neither needs a note. As far as Luca knows, Tariq still believes it is in the blue drawer, the location Luca texted him. Luca thinks Farah last saw it in the black trunk, because Luca does not know she watched the later moves through the window.

ANSWER: Tariq, Farah

Farah sees Luca put the brooch in the wicker basket. She also sees that Yara and Oksana both witness the move and can see each other. So Farah thinks Yara knows that Oksana saw Yara witness the move. In Farah’s view, Yara therefore thinks Oksana believes Yara knows the brooch is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin, and nobody moved it afterward.

ANSWER: C

Quinn expects Pablo to say “the Denver office.” Quinn heard Pablo read that assignment aloud on call 6. Pablo was absent from call 7, and Quinn does not know that Luca later told Pablo about the change to Nairobi.

ANSWER: B

Mirela reads Pablo’s message saying the account is in Denver. She knows Pablo knows she read it, so she thinks Pablo believes her answer is Denver. She does not see Luca’s later message to Pablo, so it does not change her view.

ANSWER: D

Farah thinks Tariq saw Luca watch the brooch go into the black trunk and then leave before it was moved. Her leather-bag text to Luca was private, so she does not think Tariq knew about it.

Farah also does not know that Tariq overheard her tell Luca about the blue drawer or that Luca later texted him. So, in Farah’s view, Tariq still thinks she believes Luca’s last information was the original placement in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Pablo knows Mirela read his message saying the account was in Denver. Luca’s later message about Nairobi was private, so it changes Pablo’s own belief but not what he thinks Mirela believes.

ANSWER: A

Amara did not see Yara move the marble to the green cupboard. She believes Yara’s later private message saying it is in the white cabinet, and nothing she hears afterward changes that belief.

ANSWER: D

Luca thinks Mirela heard Pablo reassign the account to Lisbon on call 2. On call 3, Luca sees that Mirela hears the change back to Nairobi, but as far as Luca knows, Mirela has no reason to think Pablo heard it. Luca knows of no later update that would change Mirela’s view of what Pablo believes. Luca’s final message updates Pablo privately, not Mirela.

ANSWER: A

Yara misses Tariq putting the whistle away, but later hears Amara say it is in the copper tin. Yara believes Amara.

ANSWER: C

Amara did not see Yara move the marble to the green cupboard. She believes Yara’s later text saying it is in the white cabinet, so she opens that cabinet first.

ANSWER: B

Mirela believes the account is in Denver. While listening to call 6, she heard Pablo read that out and saw that Quinn and Amara were on the call. As far as she knows, all three agree with her.

Mirela last saw Luca hear an assignment on call 3, when it was Nairobi. She knows nothing of Luca’s later calls or private message, so she thinks only Luca has a different view.

ANSWER: Luca

Pablo knows Mirela read his Denver message. From his perspective, Mirela therefore thinks, “Pablo knows I read it, so he thinks I believe the account is in Denver.” Luca’s later private message changes Pablo’s own belief to Nairobi, but Mirela does not see it, so it does not change that nested belief.

ANSWER: D

Amara thinks the last update Pablo heard **with both Quinn and Luca present** was the Lisbon reassignment on call 2. She doesn’t know Pablo overheard call 3. On call 6, Pablo and Quinn hear “Denver,” but Luca is absent and nobody says what Luca knows. So Amara thinks Pablo still expects Quinn to believe that Luca’s answer is Lisbon. Nothing Amara witnesses later changes that.

ANSWER: B

Luca saw Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin while Yara was in the workshop. Since Luca didn’t realize Yara missed it, he thinks she saw it too.

ANSWER: D

Jonas saw Luca move the marble to the white cabinet and knows Tariq saw Luca put it there. When Yara later moved it to the green cupboard, Luca was outside. Jonas secretly saw that move, but has no reason to think Tariq believes Luca saw it. So Jonas thinks Tariq still expects Luca to believe the marble is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

Yara saw Jonas move the marble to the black trunk. Tariq’s text tells Yara about the white cabinet, but not that Jonas knows about it. Yara also doesn’t know that Jonas watched her move the marble to the green cupboard. So she thinks Jonas still believes it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Amara says the whistle is in the copper tin. She knows Jonas heard her and could see that Tariq heard her too. So Amara thinks Jonas expects Tariq to take her at her word: she believes the whistle is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: C

Yara saw Jonas move the marble to the black trunk. Tariq’s private text later told her the marble was in the white cabinet, but not that Jonas had seen it moved there. She also doesn’t know Jonas watched her move it to the green cupboard. So Yara expects Jonas to open the black trunk first and waits beside it.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru last reassigned the Marlow account to Nairobi in step 4. She was not on the call in step 9 and was never told about the move to Osaka, so she still thinks Nairobi has the account.

ANSWER: D

In step 9, Ines reassigns the Marlow account to the Osaka office. This is the final reassignment, superseding the earlier assignment to Nairobi.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru last reassigned the Marlow account to Nairobi in step 4. She was not on the step 9 call and was never told about the change to Osaka, so she says the Nairobi office.

ANSWER: C

Luca saw that Jonas and Yara both watched the marble go into the black trunk, and that Jonas saw Yara leave before the move to the white cabinet. Luca doesn’t know that Jonas later watched Yara move the marble to the green cupboard. So Luca thinks Jonas still believes that Yara thinks the marble is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: A

Amara believes the whistle is in the copper tin. Tariq told her so, and Yara and Jonas heard her say it aloud. Luca missed the announcement. He saw Tariq put the whistle in the tin, but Amara doesn’t know he was watching, so she sends only Luca a note.

ANSWER: Luca

Luca saw Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin, but he knew Amara was outside and did not see it. Luca did not see Tariq’s private text to Amara or hear her later announcement. So Luca still thinks Amara has no idea where the whistle is.

ANSWER: E

Ines heard Xavier set the offsite location to Porto on call 5. Nothing later changed that location; the Osaka reassignment concerned the Marlow account.

ANSWER: D

Keiko saw Wanjiru hear the Denver assignment on the first call. Keiko did not hear the later reassignments involving Wanjiru, and Wanjiru was absent from the final call assigning the account to Osaka. So Keiko thinks Wanjiru still believes the account is in Denver.

ANSWER: D

Xavier hears Wanjiru reassign the account to Nairobi on call 4. Neither is on call 9, and nobody tells Xavier about the later Osaka reassignment. So Xavier still thinks Wanjiru believes the account is in Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Hana reads Ines’s message saying the offsite is in Porto. Since Ines knows Hana read it, Hana thinks Ines believes that Hana expects the offsite to be in Porto.

ANSWER: C

Keiko expects Wanjiru to say **Denver**. They both heard the Denver assignment on call 1. Keiko knows nothing about calls 2–4, and she sees that Wanjiru is absent when Ines assigns the account to Osaka on call 9. So, as far as Keiko knows, Denver is the last assignment Wanjiru heard.

ANSWER: C

On call 1, Keiko saw that Ines and Hana both heard the Denver assignment. Keiko did not hear about call 2, so she does not know that Ines saw Hana hear the Osaka reassignment. Hana was absent from call 9, so it changes Keiko’s belief about the account itself, but not her belief about what Ines thinks Hana believes. For Keiko, that remains Denver.

ANSWER: C

Xavier and Wanjiru both heard the Nairobi reassignment on call 4 and could see each other on the call. So Xavier thinks Wanjiru heard “Nairobi” and knows that Xavier heard her say it. That makes Nairobi the answer at every level of the nested belief. Neither heard the later Osaka reassignment.

ANSWER: B

Hana hears Porto chosen on call 5 and sees that Keiko is absent. Keiko learns the location on call 6, but Hana does not hear that call. Ines’s private message to Hana confirms Porto without saying that Keiko knows. So Hana thinks Keiko has no idea where the offsite is.

ANSWER: E

On the first call, everyone hears “Denver,” so Ines thinks Keiko heard Wanjiru and Ines receive the same information. Ines knows Keiko missed the second call, and nothing later tells Keiko what Wanjiru heard there.

On the final call, Keiko hears “Osaka,” but Wanjiru is absent. So Ines thinks Keiko updates her own belief to Osaka while still believing that Wanjiru thinks Ines’s answer is Denver.

ANSWER: A

Jonas saw Tariq and Yara witness the move to the black trunk. When Luca moved the marble to the white cabinet, Jonas and Tariq both saw that Yara was absent. So Luca thinks Jonas would say that Tariq still believes Yara thinks the marble is in the black trunk. Tariq’s text to Yara was private, and Luca doesn’t know Jonas watched her later move.

ANSWER: D

Xavier believes the Marlow account is in Nairobi because he heard Wanjiru reassign it on call 4. He knows Wanjiru shares that view. As far as Xavier knows, Ines and Hana still believe the account is in Osaka, and Keiko still believes it is in Denver. Xavier never learns about call 9.

ANSWER: Ines, Hana, Keiko
